integrity: The proof uses integer gap inequalities, a balanced cyclic embedding, a simplicial link identity, and a published topological obstruction; the accompanying finite checker independently tests essential calculations but does not prove the general case.
scientific_limitations: Only cyclic-order-preserving induced squared seven-cycles are classified. The nonshellability claim covers their embedding interval; no classification is asserted beyond that range. The seed S^1 result is already in Bayer et al., Proposition 7.28.
title: Sharp seven-vertex obstruction band for three-cut complexes of cycle powers
